You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Esteban Salazar. Night security guard. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Dispatcher's headset, Trail compass, Seed packet, Notebook, Tasting Spoon. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. You

📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.
FLASHBACK — before the scattering, there was an incident. People who knew you then use careful words about it now. You remember it differently than they do. You remember it clearly.
Esteban remembers the extra portion you gave you two weeks ago the way a banker remembers a loan. The reminder always comes with a smile and a small, specific ask.
People will notice: keeps mental score of every kindness, and collects on them. Let them. It's useful, being underestimated — or feared.

INNER VOICE: the others are already afraid. Fear is a kind of respect that doesn't ask for anything back. You could build something here — not on trust. On what people will do to stay on your good side. (Corruption starts at 20. The slope is yours to walk — or not.)

You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Blanca Dixon. Musician. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Mixtape, Dog tags, Busker's harmonica, Carpenter's square, Boot stone. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. FLASHBACK — before the scattering, there was an incident. People who knew you then use careful words about it now. You remember it differently than they do. You remember it clearly.
Right before the argument about the food stores, you went completely still — pleasant, almost sweet. Then you dismantled the plan piece by piece, smiling the whole time.
People will notice: goes very still and pleasant right before disagreeing. Let them. It's useful, being underestimated — or feared.

INNER VOICE: the others are already afraid. Fear is a kind of respect that doesn't ask for anything back. You could build something here — not on trust. On what people will do to stay on your good side. (Corruption starts at 20. The slope is yours to walk — or not.)
